'''Kieth Cairn''' was a victim of [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan's]] illegal, experimental surgery at the [[Cutting Edge Clinic]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. His body was buried in the caves below Mos Eisley.<ref name="EF" />
